questions.text: Network Engineering & Operations Skills: Technical mastery: (1) RF planning & optimization skills; (2) Core network management; (3) Fiber splicing & maintenance capacity; (4) Power system maintenance (solar/diesel); (5) Cybersecurity expertise; (6) Vendor certification (Huawei/Ericsson/Nokia); (7) Incident response speed.
questions.evidence_required: Staff certifications, Training logs, MTTR stats
questions.africa_specific_notes: Shortage of skilled fiber splicers and power technicians. Reliance on vendor managed services common.

questions.text: Software & Digital Development: Building apps/services: (1) App development capability (MyTelco App); (2) API management (for fintech integration); (3) Data science/Analytics capacity; (4) Agile/DevOps maturity; (5) USSD menu design (UX); (6) Legacy system integration; (7) Innovation labs.
questions.evidence_required: App store ratings, API documentation, Deployment frequency
questions.africa_specific_notes: Telcos trying to become 'TechCos'. Need internal dev talent, not just vendors. USSD UX is critical for mass market.

questions.text: Mobile Money Agent Training: Frontline skills: (1) Transaction processing (deposit/withdraw); (2) Fraud awareness (spotting fakes/social engineering); (3) Liquidity management (balancing cash/float); (4) Customer service skills; (5) Dispute resolution; (6) KYC procedure adherence; (7) Digital literacy.
questions.evidence_required: Agent training manual, Certification records, Mystery shopper scores
questions.africa_specific_notes: Agents are the face of the brand. Poorly trained agents cause fraud losses and bad UX. Liquidity management is a key skill.

questions.text: Sales & Registration Agent Skills: Onboarding users: (1) Product knowledge (bundles/tariffs); (2) SIM registration compliance (ID checks); (3) Device setup assistance; (4) Ethics (no overselling); (5) Data privacy awareness; (6) Troubleshooting basics; (7) Commission structure understanding.
questions.evidence_required: Sales training logs, Compliance audit results
questions.africa_specific_notes: Street agents often skip KYC steps to get commission. Training must emphasize compliance.

questions.text: Call Center Competence: Resolving issues: (1) First Call Resolution (FCR) rate; (2) Language support (local dialects); (3) Technical knowledge of agents; (4) Empathy & soft skills; (5) System access (can they see the problem?); (6) Escalation procedures; (7) Wait times.
questions.evidence_required: Call center metrics (FCR, AHT), QA scores, Training materials
questions.africa_specific_notes: Multi-lingual support is essential. Agents often lack tools to solve technical issues, leading to frustration.

questions.text: Self-Service & Digital Support: User empowerment: (1) USSD self-service menu clarity; (2) App functionality (buy bundles, check balance); (3) Chatbot effectiveness; (4) Knowledge base availability; (5) Community forums; (6) Ease of use; (7) Accessibility.
questions.evidence_required: Self-service adoption rates, App ratings, USSD flow diagrams
questions.africa_specific_notes: USSD is the primary interface. It must be simple and foolproof.

questions.text: User Capability & Education: Helping users connect: (1) Smartphone onboarding (how to use data); (2) Internet safety education; (3) Mobile money literacy; (4) Phishing awareness campaigns; (5) Parental control education; (6) Value-added service management; (7) Understanding tariffs.
questions.evidence_required: Education campaign reports, User surveys, Digital literacy programs
questions.africa_specific_notes: Many first-time internet users. They are vulnerable to fraud and bill shock. Telcos have a duty to educate.

questions.text: Enterprise Client Capability: B2B competence: (1) Understanding of SLAs; (2) Cloud/IoT adoption readiness; (3) Cybersecurity awareness; (4) Connectivity management; (5) API integration skills; (6) Strategic partnership potential; (7) Technical point of contact.
questions.evidence_required: Client needs assessment, B2B training workshops
questions.africa_specific_notes: SMEs need help digitizing. Telcos moving from selling connectivity to selling 'solutions' (ICT).

scoring_notes: Layer 4 (Competence) for Telecom in SSA: Agent competence is the face of the network. Engineering competence keeps the lights on. User education reduces support costs and fraud.
